title: Emit terminal optimizer route outcomes
objective: Emit exactly one authenticated terminal route outcome for scalar closed-field and strict-binary64 optimizer regions, including fast, fallback, zero-trip, and guard-error outcomes with stable reasons, outside hot loops and with unchanged production output when profiling is disabled.

handoff.summary: Scalar closed-field and strict-binary64 optimized regions now emit one private terminal event after successful fast, fallback, or zero-trip completion and immediately before established guard errors. Raw guard reasons are bounded strings, all events are outside hot loops, and generated production programs remain byte-identical when the observer is absent. Focused structural and runtime tests cover ordering, entry/terminal conservation, unchanged output, stable reasons, streaming and zip fallbacks, and incomplete ordinary fallback exceptions.
risks: The fourth observer argument depends on the engine-profiler lane to aggregate raw guard strings as telemetry.guard-failure evidence.
The generated optimizer opportunity dashboard becomes stale when compiler sources change and must be regenerated by the integration lane.
A full integration run stopped in its first batch on unrelated nativeAvailable and class-unit resource-count failures; 310 later files were not started.

The final full build passed stages 1 through 6 but its production native-pack stage was interrupted after stalling for more than four minutes; an earlier build of the implementation passed completely, and the final focused generated-code suite passes.
next_steps: Integrate with the engine-profiler collector and shared telemetry schema, then assert the aggregated guarded-fallback and error reason objects.
Regenerate the optimizer opportunity dashboard after integration.
Rerun the broad build and integration suites on the integration branch after unrelated baseline failures are resolved.
